description: This file defines a React component for a user registration form, including form handling, password strength validation, and API interaction for account creation.

classes.name: Register
classes.description: A React component class for user registration, handling form input, password validation, and registration API calls.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state and binds event handlers.

methods.name: handlePasswordChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the password input, updates password strength score.

methods.name: handleConfirmPasswordChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the password confirmation input.

methods.name: checkPasswordsMatch
methods.description: Checks if the password and confirmation match.

methods.name: onEmailChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the email input.

methods.name: onCreateAccountClicked
methods.description: Validates form and initiates registration request.

methods.name: sendRegisterRequest
methods.description: Sends registration data to the server via fetch API.

methods.name: isEmailInvalid
methods.description: Determines if the email input is invalid.

methods.name: isPasswordInvalid
methods.description: Determines if the password input is invalid.
